status: replacement problem family; solver accuracy and optimality are unproved
reason: User requires unknown nonlinear Euler dynamics. The previous affine-shear example is retained only as an optimal-reconstruction/proof-workflow exercise.
equations: Unforced, inviscid full 3D compressible ideal-gas Euler, gamma=2, evolving all five conserved variables
initial_admissibility: rho0 >= 0.95 and p0 >= 0.625 throughout the whole parameter family
nontriviality_witness: At (0,0,pi/4), rho0=1, v0=0, d_z p0=-A^2/4. The z-momentum Euler equation forces d_t(rho*v_z)|t=0=A^2/4 >= 1/16. The initial zero vertical velocity cannot remain zero.
unknowns: rho, all three velocity components, and pressure at positive time. No exact trajectory map or exact future state is provided to the solver.
input_access: All competitors receive the same explicit initial-condition formulas and parameter values. No sample-only restriction on initial density is used.

time_target.status: initial numerical target; a common smooth existence interval and regularity bounds over the family still require proof

accuracy_target: Max over the five nondimensional conserved components of the domain-volume-normalized L1 error in a specified continuous reconstruction at T. This includes spatial and temporal evolution error, not only projection error.
initial_search_class: Conservative explicit local finite-volume schemes on uniform Cartesian grids, fixed stencil radius at most two, and one to three explicit Runge-Kutta stages. Method coefficients and adaptation rules must be common across the family; all parameter-specific preprocessing is charged. This is an initial search scope, not yet a finalized formal competitor definition.
cost_target: Total scalar arithmetic/memory work for a complete solve at the requested continuum error, including setup, all accepted/rejected steps, fluxes, checks and any certification or preprocessing; wall time reported separately
proof_requirements: Prove a common smooth-time and admissibility contract, or explicitly revise the time/solution concept if it fails
Prove an actual accuracy upper bound for the selected fully discrete solver and reconstruction
Prove its total-work upper bound under a declared operational model
Finalize a scientifically justified competitor class and prove a matching worst-case lower bound tied to necessary evolution accuracy
unacceptable_substitutes: a CFL or stage-count bound alone
current_evidence: Only initial nontriviality checks and numerical baseline commissioning are intended in this stage. Refined-grid differences will not be called certified continuum error.
prior_work: Adapted from the inviscid compressible 3D Taylor-Green test used in Ranocha et al., Optimized Runge-Kutta Methods with Automatic Step Size Control for Compressible Computational Fluid Dynamics, DOI 10.1007/s42967-021-00159-w. Gamma, amplitude and density perturbation here are explicit adaptations. This is not the analytically solvable two-dimensional incompressible Taylor-Green case.
